# Module Organizationsvg image

Relevant source files

- [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)contexter.egg-info/SOURCES.txt](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/contexter.egg-info/SOURCES.txt)

## Purpose and Scopesvg image

This document describes the organization, structure, and naming conventions of implementation modules in the Contexter system. It covers the 1:1 mapping between CLI commands and Python modules, module categorization by functionality, and the registration mechanism that connects user-facing commands to their implementations.

For information about the high-level system architecture and layering principles, see [System Architecture](/ray0404/Contexter/6.1-system-architecture). For detailed documentation of the shared utility module, see [Utility Layer (contexter\_utils)](/ray0404/Contexter/6.3-utility-layer-(contexter_utils)). For command usage and behavior, see [Command Reference](/ray0404/Contexter/5-command-reference).

---

## Module Categoriessvg image

Contexter's implementation is organized into 13 Python modules divided into four functional categories:

| Category | Module Count | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Shared Infrastructure | 1 | Common utilities and helper functions used by all other modules |
| Markdown Operations | 6 | Full-featured workflow for Markdown context files |
| HTML Operations | 4 | Parallel workflow for HTML context files |
| Format Conversion | 2 | Bidirectional translation between Markdown and HTML formats |

**Sources:** [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)setup.py23-36](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/setup.py#L23-L36)

---

## Module-to-Command Mappingsvg image

### Mapping Overview Diagramsvg image

**Sources:** [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)setup.py39-53](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/setup.py#L39-L53)

### Complete Mapping Tablesvg image

Each CLI command maps exactly one-to-one to an implementation module. The entry point configuration in `setup.py` defines this mapping:

| CLI Command | Implementation Module | Entry Point | Functional Category |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `buildcontext` | `context_builder.py` | `context_builder:main` | Markdown Operations |
| `reconstructor` | `reconstructor.py` | `reconstructor:main` | Markdown Operations |
| `updatecontext` | `update_context.py` | `update_context:main` | Markdown Operations |
| `updater` | `updater.py` | `updater:main` | Markdown Operations |
| `smartupdate` | `smart_update.py` | `smart_update:main` | Markdown Operations |
| `sanitizecontext` | `sanitize_context.py` | `sanitize_context:main` | Markdown Operations |
| `buildcontexthtml` | `build_context_html.py` | `build_context_html:main` | HTML Operations |
| `reconstructorhtml` | `reconstructor_html.py` | `reconstructor_html:main` | HTML Operations |
| `updatecontexthtml` | `update_context_html.py` | `update_context_html:main` | HTML Operations |
| `updaterhtml` | `updater_html.py` | `updater_html:main` | HTML Operations |
| `md2html` | `md2html.py` | `md2html:main` | Format Conversion |
| `html2md` | `html2md.py` | `html2md:main` | Format Conversion |

Every implementation module exposes a `main()` function that serves as the entry point for the corresponding CLI command.

**Sources:** [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)setup.py39-53](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/setup.py#L39-L53)

## Module Naming Conventionssvg image

### Pattern Analysissvg image

Contexter uses consistent naming patterns to indicate module functionality and format specialization:

### Naming Rulessvg image

1. **Markdown Modules**: Use base names with underscores (e.g., `context_builder`, `update_context`)

   - Markdown is the default/primary format
   - No format suffix required
2. **HTML Modules**: Append `_html` to base name (e.g., `build_context_html`, `reconstructor_html`)

   - Explicitly indicates HTML specialization
   - Maintains parallel structure with Markdown equivalents
3. **Conversion Modules**: Use `{source_format}2{target_format}` pattern (e.g., `md2html`, `html2md`)

   - Directional naming indicates conversion direction
   - No underscores for brevity
4. **Shared Module**: `contexter_utils` has no functional suffix

   - Indicates system-wide utility role
   - Prefixed with package name for clarity
5. **CLI Command Names**: Mirror module names but remove underscores

   - `context_builder.py` → `buildcontext`
   - `update_context_html.py` → `updatecontexthtml`
   - Makes commands easier to type while maintaining traceability

**Sources:** [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)setup.py23-53](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/setup.py#L23-L53) [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)contexter.egg-info/top\_level.txt1-13](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/contexter.egg-info/top_level.txt#L1-L13)

## Module Registration and Installationsvg image

### setuptools Configurationsvg image

Contexter uses `setuptools` for package configuration. The registration process involves two key components in `setup.py`:

#### Module Declarationsvg image

The `py_modules` parameter lists all installable modules as top-level Python files:

This declares 13 modules (12 implementation + 1 shared utility) that will be installed as importable Python modules.

**Sources:** [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)setup.py23-36](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/setup.py#L23-L36)

#### Entry Point Declarationsvg image

The `entry_points` parameter maps CLI command names to module functions:

Each entry follows the pattern: `{command_name}={module_name}:{function_name}`

**Sources:** [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)setup.py39-53](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/setup.py#L39-L53)

### Installation Flow Diagramsvg image

**Sources:** [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)setup.py14-54](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/setup.py#L14-L54)

## Flat Module Structuresvg image

### Directory Organizationsvg image

Contexter uses a **flat module structure** where all implementation modules reside in the repository root directory:

```px-2
contexter/
├── contexter_utils.py           # Shared infrastructure
├── context_builder.py            # Markdown: build
├── reconstructor.py              # Markdown: reconstruct
├── update_context.py             # Markdown: update
├── updater.py                    # Markdown: apply
├── smart_update.py               # Markdown: smart update
├── sanitize_context.py           # Markdown: sanitize
├── build_context_html.py         # HTML: build
├── reconstructor_html.py         # HTML: reconstruct
├── update_context_html.py        # HTML: update
├── updater_html.py               # HTML: apply
├── md2html.py                    # Convert: MD→HTML
├── html2md.py                    # Convert: HTML→MD
├── setup.py                      # Package configuration
├── requirements.txt              # Dependencies
└── README.md                     # Documentation
```

### Rationale for Flat Structuresvg image

| Aspect | Rationale |
| --- | --- |
| **Simplicity** | Only 13 modules; no need for nested package hierarchy |
| **Discoverability** | All implementation files visible in single directory |
| **Import Simplicity** | Direct imports (`import contexter_utils`) without package paths |
| **Maintenance** | Easy to locate and modify modules without navigating subdirectories |
| **CLI Mapping** | Direct correspondence between file names and command names |

The flat structure works because:

1. Module count is manageable (13 total)
2. Clear naming conventions prevent ambiguity
3. Single shared utility module avoids circular dependencies
4. Each module is self-contained with minimal inter-module coupling

**Sources:** [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)setup.py23-36](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/setup.py#L23-L36) [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)contexter.egg-info/SOURCES.txt2-16](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/contexter.egg-info/SOURCES.txt#L2-L16)

## Module Dependency Architecturesvg image

### Dependency Patternsvg image

All implementation modules follow a **star topology** dependency pattern where they depend on the central `contexter_utils` module but not on each other:

### Dependency Characteristicssvg image

| Characteristic | Description |
| --- | --- |
| **Direction** | One-way: Implementation modules → `contexter_utils` |
| **Exclusivity** | Implementation modules do NOT import each other |
| **Centralization** | All shared code consolidated in `contexter_utils` |
| **Isolation** | Each module can be tested/modified independently |
| **No Circular Dependencies** | Star topology prevents circular import issues |

This architecture ensures:

- **Modularity**: Commands can be added/removed without affecting others
- **Testability**: Each module has single dependency (utils) for mocking
- **Maintainability**: Changes to shared logic only require updating one file
- **Clarity**: Dependency graph is trivial to understand

**Sources:** [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)setup.py23-36](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/setup.py#L23-L36)

---

## Module Size and Scopesvg image

### Module Characteristics by Categorysvg image

| Category | Module Count | Typical Module Size | Primary Responsibility |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Shared Infrastructure | 1 | Large (500+ lines) | File I/O, parsing, formatting, language detection |
| Build Operations | 2 | Medium (200-400 lines) | Directory traversal, content aggregation, syntax highlighting |
| Reconstruction | 2 | Medium (200-400 lines) | Context parsing, directory creation, file writing |
| Update/Patch | 5 | Small-Medium (100-300 lines) | Diff generation, patch application, rsync integration |
| Format Conversion | 2 | Small (100-200 lines) | Markdown↔HTML transformation |
| Sanitization | 1 | Small (100-200 lines) | AI output fixing, code fence detection |

### Single Responsibility Principlesvg image

Each module adheres to a **single, well-defined responsibility**:

Benefits of narrow scope:

- Each module can be understood in isolation
- Testing focuses on single behavior
- Changes have localized impact
- New features can be added as new modules rather than expanding existing ones

**Sources:** [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)setup.py23-36](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/setup.py#L23-L36)

---

## Module Interface Contractsvg image

### Required Interfacesvg image

Every implementation module must expose a `main()` function that serves as the CLI entry point. This function typically:

1. **Parses command-line arguments** using `argparse`
2. **Validates inputs** (file paths, options)
3. **Calls utility functions** from `contexter_utils`
4. **Handles errors** and provides user feedback
5. **Returns exit code** (0 for success, non-zero for errors)

### Interface Patternsvg image

Each module acts as a **thin CLI wrapper** around utility functions, keeping the presentation layer (CLI) separate from the business logic (utilities).

**Sources:** [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)setup.py39-53](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/setup.py#L39-L53)

---

## Module Installation Artifactssvg image

### Generated Filessvg image

When Contexter is installed, `setuptools` generates several artifacts in the `contexter.egg-info/` directory:

| File | Purpose | Content |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `top_level.txt` | Lists installed modules | Module names (one per line) |
| `SOURCES.txt` | Lists source files | All files included in distribution |
| `requires.txt` | Lists dependencies | External package requirements |
| `PKG-INFO` | Package metadata | Version, author, description |
| `dependency_links.txt` | Additional dependency sources | (typically empty) |

The `top_level.txt` file reflects the installed module structure:

Note: `sanitize_context` may be missing from older installations (added in v2.0.0).

**Sources:** [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)contexter.egg-info/top\_level.txt1-13](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/contexter.egg-info/top_level.txt#L1-L13) [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)contexter.egg-info/SOURCES.txt1-21](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/contexter.egg-info/SOURCES.txt#L1-L21)

---

## Summarysvg image

Contexter's module organization follows these key principles:

1. **1:1 Mapping**: Each CLI command maps to exactly one implementation module
2. **Flat Structure**: All 13 modules in repository root for simplicity
3. **Consistent Naming**: Format-specific suffixes (`_html`) and conversion patterns (`md2html`)
4. **Star Topology**: All modules depend on `contexter_utils`, not each other
5. **Single Responsibility**: Each module handles one specific operation
6. **Thin CLI Layer**: Modules are thin wrappers calling utility functions
7. **Standard Interface**: Every module exposes a `main()` function as entry point

This organization enables independent module development, clear dependency management, and straightforward command-to-code traceability.

**Sources:** [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)setup.py1-61](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/setup.py#L1-L61) [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)contexter.egg-info/top\_level.txt1-13](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/contexter.egg-info/top_level.txt#L1-L13) [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)contexter.egg-info/SOURCES.txt1-21](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/contexter.egg-info/SOURCES.txt#L1-L21)
